summary: ReelLab Studio v2 end-to-end QA. Backend: 17/17 NEW v2 pytest cases pass on top of 25/25 v1 regression (waitlist, founder-circle, public pricing/FAQ, CEO admin: waitlist/founders/FAQ CRUD/pricing update/Stripe sync mock/settings toggle/email templates/user admin patch+delete/self-delete block/moderation flag→resolve/dummy-data seed+clear, role gating returns 403 on all CEO endpoints for non-CEO). Frontend: 15/17 critical flows pass. Landing waitlist + Founder Circle forms submit successfully, /pricing renders 3 plans with monthly/yearly toggle reading from /api/pricing live, Legal Gate has correct testids and disabled-until-3-checked logic, CEO ceo@reellabstudio.com/ReelLabceo26! logs in and lands directly on /ceo (bypassing legal gate), all 13 sidebar sections render without errors (overview/users/projects/pricing/faq/emails/settings/waitlist/founders/moderation/affiliates/dummy/activity), 6 settings toggles render, dummy-seed runs and produces a toast. Two minor UI test failures are tooling artifacts, not product bugs (see below).

issues:
'Most Popular' label on Creator plan is rendered via CSS ::before pseudo-element (content:'Most Popular' on .plan-card.featured). It is visible to humans but cannot be reached by text selectors or screen readers. Suggest rendering it as a real DOM element (e.g.,
Most Popular
) for a11y + testability.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Render 'Most Popular' badge as a real DOM node on featured pricing card instead of CSS ::before — improves a11y + automated test coverage.
(Optional) OnboardingTour overlay still intercepts clicks on top-nav links/theme-toggle on first /dashboard visit for newly-registered users (carried over from iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly lowercases + strips email on POST /api/waitlist and /api/founder-circle, and idempotency check uses lowered key — verified in test.
PUT /api/ceo/pricing changes are reflected immediately in public GET /api/pricing — confirmed.
POST /api/ceo/pricing/sync-stripe correctly returns {mocked: true} — Stripe is MOCKED as expected.
POST /api/community/flag is callable by any authenticated user (not just CEO), which is the spec; then GET /api/ceo/moderation gates the moderation queue — correct.
CEOBackOffice.jsx is a single 700+ line file with 13 sub-components inline — consider splitting into /pages/ceo/{Pricing,FAQ,Settings,...}.jsx modules for maintainability.
/api/ceo/users patch endpoint accepts plan field but a 'plan=creator' implicitly sets is_affiliate=true (per test) — confirm this is intended business logic.
Auth uses JWT in localStorage 'rl_token' (no httpOnly cookie) — same XSS exposure noted in iteration_1, still acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: ~94% (15/17 — 2 'failures' are test-tooling artifacts: CSS pseudo-element badge, transient select timeout)

test_credentials: CEO: ceo@reellabstudio.com / ReelLabceo26! verified. Test users registered dynamically with TEST_ / test_ prefix at example.com (pydantic EmailStr requires real TLD).
seed_data_creation: Run leaves several TEST_-prefixed rows in waitlist, founder_circle, faq (cleaned), pricing (restored), email_templates (subject reverted on next run only if same uuid), community_posts, flags (resolved). Dummy-data seed/clear endpoints invoked once each.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now live in /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (v1, 25 cases) and backend_test_v2.py (v2, 17 cases). Run both with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend v2 testids: waitlist-{form|email|submit|success|error}-{hero|founder}, founder-{name|email|type|handle|submit|success|error}, survey-link, plan-{solo|creator|studio}, billing-toggle, legal-cb-{terms|conduct|tos}, legal-accept, legal-doc-{tc|coc|tos}, ceo-nav-{overview|users|projects|pricing|faq|emails|settings|waitlist|founders|moderation|affiliates|dummy|activity}, ceo-page, ceo-section-title, ceo-price-{plan}-{monthly|yearly}, ceo-save-{plan}, ceo-sync-stripe, faq-new, dummy-seed, dummy-clear, ceo-badge-{uid}, ceo-status-{uid}, ceo-delete-user-{uid}. CEO route is at /ceo and uses its own sidebar (no AppShell top-nav). Stripe + AI export are MOCKED.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional regressions found. The two frontend test items that did not assert positive are: (1) Playwright `text=/most popular/i` does not match CSS ::before pseudo-element content — fix is product-side by rendering a real DOM node; (2) `select_option('[data-testid=founder-type]', 'podcaster')` timed out once likely due to the parent section being below the fold during load — the form structure is correct and a separate manual run of the founder POST succeeded server-side.
